name: Bafauri
instructions: 1. Soak the chana dal for 4-5 hours and grind it into a coarse paste with ginger, green chilies, and minimal water.
2. Add finely chopped onions, chopped coriander, turmeric powder, salt, a pinch of asafoetida, and cumin seeds to the batter and mix well.
3. Grease small bowls or a steamer plate with a little oil.
4. Pour small portions of the batter into the containers.
5. Steam the batter for 10-15 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
6. Remove, let it cool slightly, and serve warm with green chutney or tomato sauce.
description: Bafauri is a quintessential Chhattisgarhi snack that is highly valued for being oil-free or low-fat, as it is primarily steamed. It is a nutritious alternative to deep-fried fritters (pakoras) and is commonly prepared in households as an evening tea-time snack.
